#2597 fix-forward pushed at 4dfe251b7b8bdf5935b85c5dc88c5e51c595dfd1 (plain push).
- ci.yml: Build timeout back to 25, stress step removed (ci.yml and ci-gate-tiers.toml now identical to main; the tiers file only models ci.yml Build steps).
- Stress moved to a new job in the existing weekly-linux.yml (schedule + workflow_dispatch), job timeout 60 / step 40 (cold compile + ~18 min stress).
- Guardrail test now pins #[ignore], the scheduled+dispatch job, --ignored --exact, bounded timeouts, absence from ci.yml, and Build timeout == 25; 6 break-tests each fail.
- Docs/AGENTS.md updated. make check-ci-fast passes.
Question: your ruling said nightly/dispatch; this is WEEKLY + dispatch (it reuses the existing ignored-test weekly workflow). Accept weekly, or do you want a separate nightly workflow? I'll start the fresh STANDARD wiring-delta review on green Build unless you say nightly.
subject: #2597 fix-forward pushed (weekly+dispatch) - nightly needed?
